text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Left, right, left... Kita-chan, hang in there with your right leg!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh! My legs are getting all tangled up~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm somehow managing to dance because Dia-chan is leading, but...
Wait, am I even dancing properly!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. With a bit more practice,
I'm sure it'll turn into an elegant dance.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Graceful?! C-Can I really do that...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks for showing me such a cute dance♪
Are you practicing for Ligne Droite?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Pair dancing is really difficult...
The new students enrolling next month will be coming too, so I want to dance cool like a proper senior, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I know! Fine-san,
would you mind showing us how it's done?
I suspect paired dancing comes quite naturally to you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sure thing~. Well then, Satono-chan, shall we dance?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I would also like to watch your movements
and learn from you, Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: In that case, someone... Ah, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur, help me out! I need to ask the Satono girls
about the soirée at the end of this month—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!
I haven't even told you what I need yet~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just hearing the word 'Droite' is plenty!
I ain't had no interest in that crap from the start!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Shakur, please grant me the honor
of serving as your partner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ei!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, gotcha wide open~♪ Satono-chan and the others asked me
to show them an example of the dance.
Be my partner, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...For a second, I thought that was a real application!
Don't be so misleading! ...And besides..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —It should be the other way around, based on our heights!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You're great at leading, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's natural since we do it in class.
Failing to dance and getting stuck with supplementary lessons is a waste of time."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa! So cool!!
What a graceful dance...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Neither of your postures waver at all, and your steps are flawless.
We have to aim for dancing just like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's right!
Alright, Dia-chan, let's get back to practice!
